text: Make the autonomous loop mission-continuous and evidence-driven
description: Keep the loop running indefinitely: orient to the highest-value mission, select an actionable descendant, verify and record evidence, then return and reprioritize. New instances should not pin a leaf aim by default. Explicit targets must fall back after completion; provider stream errors must fail visibly rather than enter a successful cooldown. Core worker and MCP prompts should state this invariant once, leanly.
reflection: Implemented infinite-loop semantics: new instances default to dynamic aim selection and never-stop policy; completed/missing explicit targets fall back to the next prioritized open aim; streamed provider errors fail the cycle instead of cooling down as success. Condensed default worker and MCP prompts around one invariant: mission → actionable descendant → real evidence → reprioritize indefinitely. Verification: loop-worker typecheck passed; backend build passed; MCP build passed; 3 focused loop policy/capability tests passed.

reflections.context: Live Stop-hook evidence showed that an empty actionable queue could still produce useful work, but only because the hook prompt supplied exploration guidance. get_prioritized_aims itself returned mission containers as its connected-uncommitted fallback, so other MCP clients lacked the same graph-native recovery contract.
reflections.outcome: Changed prioritization to treat only connected uncommitted open leaves as executable fallback work. When neither a committed nor connected-uncommitted actionable leaf exists, selectionScope is mission-containers-exploration and the response includes a required exploration contract: inspect hygiene/reflections, step back and decompose abstract missions, formulate a falsifiable safe reversible hypothesis with verification/stop condition, search before create, connect and phase-commit new work, and avoid low-value activity or Markdown-only plans. Updated the tool description and fallback diagnostic wording.
reflections.effectiveness: Two focused get_prioritized_aims tests pass: hidden actionable leaf fallback remains intact, and a cyclic mission-container frontier returns the exploration contract with no false leaf fallback. MCP TypeScript build and git diff --check pass. An initially misordered name-filter command also ran unrelated system tests and surfaced two existing tools-system failures; the correctly scoped tools-aims run passed 2/2.
reflections.lesson: Mission continuity must be encoded at the graph-tool boundary, not depend on one agent surface's prompt. Containers provide orientation; they must never masquerade as executable leaves when the system should enter explicit hypothesis-generation mode.

status.comment: Mission-continuous loop now includes a graph-native empty-frontier exploration contract and leaf-only hidden-work fallback; internally verified, awaiting explicit acceptance.
